WITH step1 AS (
  SELECT rating, AVG(length) as avg_len
  FROM film
  WHERE length IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY rating
),
step2 AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_len) as overall_avg
  FROM step1
),
step3 AS (
  SELECT 
    step1.rating,
    step1.avg_len,
    step1.avg_len - step2.overall_avg as diff
  FROM step1
  CROSS JOIN step2
  WHERE step1.avg_len > step2.overall_avg
),
step4 AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_len) as avg_avg
  FROM step3
),
step5 AS (
  SELECT 
    step3.rating,
    step3.avg_len,
    step3.diff,
    step3.avg_len - step4.avg_avg as diff2
  FROM step3
  CROSS JOIN step4
  WHERE step3.avg_len > step4.avg_avg
)
SELECT 
  AVG(avg_len),
  AVG(diff),
  AVG(diff2)
FROM step5
